build_task_template: build a PHYRE task template that places two jars on plateaus with parameterized positions
create_static_bar: create a static bar object in the PHYRE scene with a given scale and position
create_dynamic_jar: create a dynamic jar object placed on top of a plateau in the PHYRE scene
update_task_relationships: update the PHYRE task to require two jars to be in a touching spatial relationship
set_solution_tier: set the PHYRE task metadata to the PRE_TWO_BALLS solution tier level
